1, Capture Target; there is one place the players must capture and defend for the greater good
1, Defend Target; players must defend a vital point or risk endangering others.
1, Race; players must get to another location in a set amount of time
1, Capture; players must prevent somebody else from getting to a certain place in a certain amount of time.
1, Cursed; there is some place that is passively cursed or dangerous, and threatens to have the danger realized
1, Recent Ruins; some place gets destroyed and it is up to the players to figure out why.
1, Protect; players must protect something important
1, Steal; players must steal something important, or otherwise get it out of the wrong hands.
1, Deliver; players are entrusted with an object and must deliver it
1, Intercept; players must change the destination of an object, or capture it in transit.
1, Create; players must fix the reactor, gather the seven stones, eta
1, Destroy; players must crush the idol of evil, disable the shield array, eta.
1, Change; players must alter the properties of an object somehow
1, Maintain; players must stop the properties of an important object from being altered.
1, Gather; players must collect alot of an object, be it food, or money for a crushing debt
1, Disperse; players must break open the vault and give the money back to the masses, or steal the wizards collection of power amulets and bury them at the four corners of the earth, eta.
1, Sell; players must sell an object, or run a buisiness, or make a living
1, Buy; players need something and must track it down and get the best deal possible, or they must run an institution or establishment, or budget something they are not used to managing.
